notes: ACCESS: direct curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome) worked throughout, no WAF encountered; robots.txt carries no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web rule. r.jina.ai returned 403 on every attempt this session and translate.goog 403, so no live rendered-header read was possible - see QTY. TREE: from two independent sources that agree. (1) Magento GraphQL at mage.barkerandstonehouse.co.uk/index.php/graphql, query categories(filters:{}) -> 470 nodes with id/name/url_path/path/product_count, rebuilt into the full tree. (2) The site's mega-menu, which is present in the server-rendered HTML of every page (div.meganav-content__item, 12 panels: Garden, Sofas, Chairs, Tables, Bedroom, Storage, Accessories, Rooms, Brands, Inspiration, Clearance). The mega-menu groups each department's links into columns by TYPE, SIZE, MATERIAL, COLOUR and BRAND, which made the facet-vs-category split unambiguous. QTY: the product grids are rendered client-side by Searchspring (siteId zzw53h); main.js shows the PLP calling searchspring search.json with filter.category_hierarchy=<Name>Name>...>. I queried that same endpoint per category and paged it to the end at resultsPerPage=100, counting unique product 'uid' values (brief section 4 method 3, full enumeration). pagination.totalResults is exactly ONE higher than the number of products the engine actually returns, on 70 of 70 categories tested - the same +1 phantom the prior Home-Decor pass on this site found on 16 of 16 categories, where the exhaustive unique-id count matched the live-rendered 'N Products' header exactly. qty is therefore the exhaustive unique-id count, never totalResults. SANITY CHECKS: (a) discrimination - a nonsense hierarchy string returns 0, and every category returns a different number, so no site-wide constant; (b) drift - five categories re-enumerated at the end of the session returned identical counts; (c) every leaf URL was fetched live, all HTTP 200 with an h1 matching the intended category, so no silent parent-serving; (d) Magento categoryList product_count captured for every node as a third source - it agrees exactly on about 40 of 68 nodes and is higher on most of the rest (Corner Sofas 101 vs 87, Conservatory Furniture 20 vs 15, Divan Beds 34 vs 40 lower), so it was rejected in favour of the enumeration, consistent with the known Magento-inflation precedent. EXCLUDED as facets rather than categories (using the site's own mega-menu columns): seater-count sofa pages (2 / 2.5 / 3 / 4 Seater), all material pages (Leather, Fabric, Velvet, Boucle, Wood, Glass, Metal, Marble, Oak, Reclaimed, Upholstered, Rattan, Teak, Rope, Aluminium, Recycled Plastic, Stone), all colour pages, table shape pages (Round, Square, Oval, Rectangle), bed size pages (Double, King, Super King), Extending Dining Tables (a mechanism facet with no Magento category behind it), Pet Friendly Sofas, Curved Garden Furniture, Upholstered Chairs (497 - a material re-cut spanning the whole Chairs tree), Dining Chairs With Arms and Swivel Dining Chairs (attribute re-cuts of Dining Chairs), and every '...>Reclaimed' child under Storage and Tables. EXCLUDED as non-taxonomy per brief section 3: All / View-all pages, Ranges and every named range (Bedroom Ranges, Dining Ranges, Sofa Ranges, Lomax, Linen Collection, English Heritage), Brands and every brand sub-tree (Ercol, Stressless, Timothy Oulton, Kartell, Orla Kiely, Pure Furniture, Tetrad, Tempur, Vispring, Simba, Somnus and the rest), New In, Bestsellers, Need It Quick, In Time for Christmas, Christmas Gift Ideas, Black Friday, Clearance and all its children, Store Clearance, Online Exclusives, Interior Trends and its style collections, Shop the Look, Sustainable Collection, Sustainable Dining, Trees4Trees, UGC, Vicky, Cool Bedroom Picks, Home Office Essentials, The Art of Collecting, Fabric Samples, Gift Vouchers. EXCLUDED as out of scope per brief section 1: Mattresses and all its children plus mattress protectors, toppers, pillows, duvets and bedding; the whole Accessories department (lighting, mirrors, art, clocks, vases, bowls, candle holders, trays, rugs, cushions, throws, artificial plants, pots and planters); Garden Accessories (outdoor cushions, furniture covers, parasols, outdoor lighting); Garden Care; Outdoor Play (its SKUs are a throw and a wall plate - mis-filed decor); the garden Storage Boxes node (0 SKUs). KEPT WITH FLAGS: Baskets and Trunks (all 6 SKUs are wooden trunks and trunk coffee tables, i.e. furniture chests, despite the node name), Occasional Tables (umbrella that is effectively Coffee + Side Tables), Low Back and High Back Sofas (the site's own style column, alongside Chesterfield / Curved / Tech, not the size or material columns), Outdoor Kitchen Units and Garden Storage (identical 2-SKU populations), and the five room hubs under Rooms, whose products are already counted in the product-type tree. EMPTY NODES NOT EMITTED: Garden Furniture > Sun Loungers, Day Beds and Rising Table each enumerate to 0 products and are absent from the mega-menu. HIERARCHY NOTE: Beds (/bed-frames, 141 products) is emitted as a grouping row because it has two real product-type children (Divan Beds and Ottoman Beds, 68 between them); per the deepest-subcategory rule the parent is not recorded as a leaf, so roughly 73 plain bed frames sit under no leaf row. The same applies to Garden Tables and Garden Chairs.
